parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
 SELECT $1::uuid analysis_run_id,$2::text pipeline_version,$3::smallint replicate_index,$4::text owner
), locked AS (
 SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended((SELECT analysis_run_id::text||':'||pipeline_version||':'||replicate_index FROM input),0))
), run_state AS (
 SELECT i.analysis_run_id,r.documents_total,count(d.id)::int registered_count,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.status IN ('pending','processing','completed') AND d.download_url IS NOT NULL AND d.file_extension IN ('pdf','docx','xlsx'))::int processable_count,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.status='failed')::int failed_count,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.status IN ('pending','processing','completed') AND d.download_url IS NOT NULL AND d.file_extension IN ('pdf','docx','xlsx')
    AND (coalesce(d.file_name,'')='' OR coalesce(d.mime_type,'')='' OR d.file_size IS NULL OR d.file_size<0 OR d.file_size>52428800
      OR coalesce(d.ingestion_metadata->>'content_sha256','') !~* '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'))::int invalid_identity_count
 FROM input i CROSS JOIN locked LEFT JOIN public.tender_analysis_runs r ON r.id=i.analysis_run_id
 LEFT JOIN public.tender_analysis_documents d ON d.analysis_run_id=r.id
 GROUP BY i.analysis_run_id,r.documents_total
), inserted_job AS (
 INSERT INTO public.tender_agentic_jobs(analysis_run_id,pipeline_version,replicate_index,status,model,reasoning_effort,
 field_catalog_version,field_catalog_sha256,expected_documents,dispatch_execution_id)
 SELECT rs.analysis_run_id,i.pipeline_version,i.replicate_index,'staging','gpt-5.6-sol','high','tender_fields_v1','ABCBEA68911CE9FFAD9D436C9EABE708E12DBC4F04F7D5591CAFE4C58359B843',rs.processable_count,i.owner
 FROM run_state rs,input i WHERE rs.documents_total IS NOT NULL AND rs.registered_count=rs.documents_total
 AND rs.processable_count>0 AND rs.failed_count=0 AND rs.invalid_identity_count=0
 ON CONFLICT (analysis_run_id,pipeline_version,replicate_index) DO NOTHING RETURNING *,'dispatch'::text claim_mode
), existing_job AS (
 SELECT j.* FROM public.tender_agentic_jobs j,input i
 WHERE j.analysis_run_id=i.analysis_run_id AND j.pipeline_version=i.pipeline_version AND j.replicate_index=i.replicate_index
), claimed_existing AS (
 UPDATE public.tender_agentic_jobs j SET
  dispatch_execution_id=i.owner,
  status=CASE WHEN j.status='failed' THEN 'ready' ELSE 'staging' END,
  error_code=CASE WHEN j.status='failed' THEN NULL ELSE j.error_code END,
  error_message=CASE WHEN j.status='failed' THEN NULL ELSE j.error_message END,
  updated_at=now()
 FROM input i,run_state rs
 WHERE j.analysis_run_id=i.analysis_run_id AND j.pipeline_version=i.pipeline_version AND j.replicate_index=i.replicate_index
 AND j.dispatch_execution_id IS NULL
 AND rs.documents_total IS NOT NULL AND rs.registered_count=rs.documents_total AND rs.processable_count>0 AND rs.failed_count=0 AND rs.invalid_identity_count=0
 AND (j.status='created' OR (j.status='failed' AND j.attempts<2 AND coalesce(j.error_code,'') IN ('CODEX_TRANSPORT_ERROR','CODEX_TIMEOUT','RUNNER_RESTART_RECOVERABLE')))
 RETURNING j.*,CASE WHEN j.status='ready' THEN 'retry' ELSE 'dispatch' END claim_mode
), owned AS (
 SELECT * FROM inserted_job UNION ALL SELECT * FROM claimed_existing
), selected AS (
 SELECT o.* FROM owned o
 UNION ALL
 SELECT e.*,
  CASE WHEN e.dispatch_execution_id=(SELECT owner FROM input) AND e.status='staging' THEN 'dispatch'
       WHEN e.dispatch_execution_id=(SELECT owner FROM input) AND e.status='ready' THEN 'retry'
       ELSE 'noop' END claim_mode
 FROM existing_job e WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM owned)
 LIMIT 1
), source_docs AS (
 SELECT d.*,row_number() over(order by d.document_index,d.id)::int stable_index
 FROM public.tender_analysis_documents d,selected j
 WHERE d.analysis_run_id=j.analysis_run_id AND d.status IN ('pending','processing','completed')
 AND d.download_url IS NOT NULL AND d.file_extension IN ('pdf','docx','xlsx')
), inserted_docs AS (
 INSERT INTO public.tender_agentic_documents(job_id,analysis_run_id,source_document_id,artifact_key,document_index,file_name,mime_type,source_sha256,byte_size,status)
 SELECT j.id,j.analysis_run_id,d.id,'doc-'||lpad(d.stable_index::text,4,'0'),d.stable_index,d.file_name,d.mime_type,
 upper(d.ingestion_metadata->>'content_sha256'),d.file_size,'pending' FROM source_docs d CROSS JOIN selected j
 WHERE j.claim_mode='dispatch'
 ON CONFLICT (job_id,source_document_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING 1
)
SELECT s.id job_id,s.analysis_run_id,s.pipeline_version,s.replicate_index,s.status,s.attempts,s.field_catalog_version,s.field_catalog_sha256,
 s.input_manifest_sha256,s.dispatch_execution_id,rs.documents_total,rs.registered_count,rs.processable_count,rs.failed_count,rs.invalid_identity_count,
 CASE WHEN rs.documents_total IS NULL OR rs.registered_count<>rs.documents_total OR rs.processable_count<=0 OR rs.failed_count>0 OR rs.invalid_identity_count>0 THEN 'reject'
      ELSE coalesce(s.claim_mode,'noop') END action,
 coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('source_document_id',d.id,'artifact_key','doc-'||lpad(d.stable_index::text,4,'0'),
 'document_index',d.stable_index,'file_name',d.file_name,'file_name_base64',encode(convert_to(d.file_name,'UTF8'),'base64'),'mime_type',d.mime_type,'source_sha256',upper(d.ingestion_metadata->>'content_sha256'),
 'byte_size',d.file_size,'download_url',d.download_url) ORDER BY d.stable_index) FROM source_docs d),'[]'::jsonb) documents
FROM run_state rs LEFT JOIN selected s ON true;

nodes.name: Создать или загрузить job и manifest

parameters.query:
UPDATE public.tender_agentic_documents
SET status='staged', staged_sha256=$3::text, runner_storage_key=$4::text, error_code=NULL,error_message=NULL,updated_at=now()
WHERE job_id=$1::uuid AND source_document_id=$2::uuid
  AND $3::text=source_sha256 AND $4::text=artifact_key
RETURNING job_id,source_document_id,artifact_key;

WITH counts AS (
 SELECT j.id,j.expected_documents,
 count(d.*)::int total_count,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.status='staged')::int staged_count,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.status IN ('pending','uploading','failed'))::int incomplete_count,
 COUNT(DISTINCT d.artifact_key)::int artifact_count,
 COUNT(DISTINCT d.document_index)::int index_count
 FROM public.tender_agentic_jobs j LEFT JOIN public.tender_agentic_documents d ON d.job_id=j.id
 WHERE j.id=$1::uuid GROUP BY j.id
), updated AS (
 UPDATE public.tender_agentic_jobs j SET status='ready',staged_documents=c.staged_count,updated_at=now()
 FROM counts c WHERE j.id=c.id AND c.total_count=c.expected_documents AND c.staged_count=c.expected_documents
 AND c.incomplete_count=0 AND c.artifact_count=c.expected_documents AND c.index_count=c.expected_documents
 RETURNING j.*
)
SELECT *, (total_count=expected_documents AND staged_count=expected_documents AND incomplete_count=0
 AND artifact_count=expected_documents AND index_count=expected_documents) barrier_ok FROM counts JOIN updated ON updated.id=counts.id;

UPDATE public.tender_agentic_jobs SET status='running',dispatch_execution_id=$2::text,input_manifest_sha256=$3::text,
attempts=GREATEST(attempts,$4::smallint),runner_started_at=coalesce(runner_started_at,now()),heartbeat_at=now(),updated_at=now()
WHERE id=$1::uuid AND status IN ('ready','running') AND staged_documents=expected_documents
RETURNING 'tender_agentic_dispatch_v1' schema_version,true success,false no_op,id job_id,status;

WITH failed_document AS (
 UPDATE public.tender_agentic_documents d SET status='failed',error_code=left($2::text,80),error_message=left($3::text,500),updated_at=now()
 FROM public.tender_agentic_jobs j
 WHERE d.job_id=$1::uuid AND d.source_document_id=NULLIF($5::text,'')::uuid
 AND j.id=d.job_id AND j.dispatch_execution_id=$4::text AND j.status IN ('created','staging','ready')
 RETURNING d.source_document_id
), failed_job AS (
 UPDATE public.tender_agentic_jobs SET status='failed',error_code=left($2::text,80),error_message=left($3::text,500),updated_at=now()
 WHERE id=$1::uuid AND dispatch_execution_id=$4::text AND status IN ('created','staging','ready')
 RETURNING *
)
SELECT 'tender_agentic_dispatch_v1' schema_version,false success,id job_id,status,error_code,error_message,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM failed_document)::int failed_documents FROM failed_job;
